description: Presidential Secretariat - Order call Out all the Member of the Armed forces for the Maintenance of Public Order with effect From 22nd July 2024
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued under the Public Security Ordinance, which is a legal/regulatory instrument. It exercises powers vested by statute (Chapter 40) to call out armed forces for maintaining public order, making it a statutory instrument and regulatory action rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the President's name is incidental to the legal authority being exercised, not the primary focus of the document.
